data.translation_aya_text: Demi langit dan yang datang pada malam hari.
data.translation_en: CONSIDER the heavens and that which comes in the night!

data.translation_aya_text: Dan tahukah kamu apakah yang datang pada malam hari itu?
data.translation_en: And what could make thee conceive what it is that comes in the night?
It is the star that pierces through [life's] darkness:

data.aya_text: اِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۗ
data.translation_en: [for] no human being has ever been left unguarded.

data.translation_aya_text: Maka hendaklah manusia memperhatikan dari apa dia diciptakan.
data.translation_en: LET MAN, then, observe out of what he has been created:

data.translation_aya_text: Dia diciptakan dari air (mani) yang terpancar,
data.translation_en: he has been created out of a seminal fluid

data.translation_aya_text: yang keluar dari antara tulang punggung (sulbi) dan tulang dada.
data.translation_en: issuing from between the loins [of man] and the pelvic arch [of woman].

data.translation_aya_text: Sungguh, Allah benar-benar kuasa untuk mengembalikannya (hidup setelah mati).
data.translation_en: Now, verily, He [who thus creates man in the first instance] is well able to bring him back [to life]
on the Day when all secrets will be laid bare,

data.aya_text: فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَّلَا نَاصِرٍۗ
data.translation_aya_text: maka manusia tidak lagi mempunyai suatu kekuatan dan tidak (pula) ada penolong.
data.translation_en: and [man] will have neither strength nor helper!
and the earth, bursting forth with plants!

data.translation_aya_text: sungguh, (Al-Qur'an) itu benar-benar firman pemisah (antara yang hak dan yang batil),
data.translation_en: BEHOLD, this [divine writ] is indeed a word that between truth and falsehood,

data.translation_aya_text: Sungguh, mereka (orang kafir) merencanakan tipu daya yang jahat.
data.translation_en: Behold, they [who refuse to accept it] devise many a false argument [to disprove its truth];

data.translation_aya_text: Dan Aku pun membuat rencana (tipu daya) yang jitu.
data.translation_en: but I shall bring all their scheming to nought.

data.translation_aya_text: Karena itu berilah penangguhan kepada orang-orang kafir itu. Berilah mereka itu kesempatan untuk sementara waktu.
data.translation_en: Let, then, the deniers of the truth have their will: let them have their will for a little while.
